page.title: Configuration
page.intro: Everything configurable in the system. The settings and feature flags below take effect at once, without a restart, and every change is written to the audit log.

Features.title: Feature flags
Features.description: Turn features on or off without a restart.

SlaCalendar.title: Reply calendar
SlaCalendar.description: How the Ask a Teacher reply time counts days. During an exam period every day counts.

PlanLimits.title: Plan limits
PlanLimits.description: Limits of the Free plan, the Base plan and the Ask a Teacher add-on.

Grading.title: AI grading
Grading.description: The confidence below which an AI grade goes to teacher review.

Uploads.title: Upload limits
Uploads.description: Allowed photo and voice recording sizes and lengths.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure (read-only)
infrastructure.intro: These values are set through environment variables at deploy time and cannot be changed here. Secret values are never shown.

safety.title: Safety switches
safety.note: Not editable here, because they could let fake payments through or bypass security.

ai.title: AI service
ai.notUsed: The API uses its built-in fakes and does not call the AI service.
ai.unreachable: The AI service could not be reached.

examPeriods.title: Exam periods
examPeriods.description: Every day counts toward the reply time between these dates, weekends included. Dates follow the calendar's time zone; open questions are updated at the next check.
examPeriods.errorTitle: Could not load the exam periods.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this exam period?
deleteDialog.body: Weekends will count normally again during {name}. Open questions are updated at the next check.

toast.failed: Could not save the exam period.

validation.rangeInvalid: The last day must be on or after the first day.
